author: Thomas_Shoes
body:
Yesterday, I was born on Avicus for ban evasion of a hacker.

This is a false ban evasion (but it has happened before).  Everyone at my school (and county) has the same IP because our school gave out labtops to everyone:  https://www.arlnow.com/2014/08/27/aps-to-give-hs-freshmen-macbooks/.

This is why me and former player corkscrew102 have the same IPs.  That was corkscrew102 ban evading not me, he has done it numerous times in the past (I guess you can see it in infraction history).
Michael already knows about this and here are some conversations about it on skype: 

[1/3/16, 10:16:08 PM] Thomas Shoemaker: IM NOT CORKSCREW102
[1/3/16, 10:16:17 PM] michael: Your IP matches him
[1/3/16, 10:16:25 PM] Thomas Shoemaker: Thomas Shoemaker created a group conversation
[1/3/16, 10:16:40 PM] michael: And I banned Thomas_Shoes
[1/3/16, 10:16:42 PM] michael: not Thomas_Shoe
[1/3/16, 10:16:52 PM] Thomas Shoemaker: Thomas_Shoes is the account i use now
[1/3/16, 10:17:13 PM] michael: The most recent IP you logged on with matches corkscrew102
[1/3/16, 10:17:20 PM] Thomas Shoemaker: We have school macs
[1/3/16, 10:17:25 PM] Thomas Shoemaker: from the same school
[1/3/16, 10:17:40 PM] Thomas Shoemaker: Please look back 2 years ago
[1/3/16, 10:17:46 PM] michael: Very well
[1/3/16, 10:17:50 PM] Thomas Shoemaker: And youll realize me and corkscrew were both active members
[1/3/16, 10:17:54 PM] michael: I see a previous infraction appealed
[1/3/16, 10:17:58 PM] michael: So I'll unban
